items.q: Can I install the app on TV?
items.a: Yes! You can download the IPTV Smarters app on your TV and request login credentials (username and password) from us to start watching. ▶️ Video tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ozhBBVaG0A

items.q: How to get the username and password for the App?
items.a: To get your APP login details, click here to subscribe: @kozeetvbuy_bot

items.q: How to sign in the app?
items.a: Once you've downloaded the app and received your login details, log in by entering: • Name: any name • Username: the one you received • Password: the one you received • URL: the one you received ▶️ Video tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ozhBBVaG0A

items.q: How can I pay to subscribe?
items.a: You need to buy Telegram Stars first — find them in Telegram Settings → My Stars (if you don't have any, buy directly from Google Play or the iPhone App Store). Then use your Telegram Stars to subscribe here: @kozeetvbuy_bot
